svg.title: A client with placenta previa is being discharged on home care at 30 weeks. Which instructions does the nurse include? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: With previa the placenta lies over or near the cervix, so anything in the vagina can start a hemorrhage: pelvic rest , and no vaginal exams . Any bleeding means return immediately, and serial ultrasounds track whether the placenta moves away from the cervix.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Early Pregnancy Bleeding & Ectopic
Pregnancy
Read the situation
A client with placenta previa is being
discharged on home care at 30 weeks. Which
instructions does the nurse include?
Select all that apply.
What fits here
Nothing in the vagina: no intercourse,
tampons or douching · Return right away
for any vaginal bleeding · Limit activity
as your provider prescribes · Keep your
follow-up ultrasound…
Why it fits
With previa the placenta lies over or near
the cervix, so anything in the vagina can
start a hemorrhage: pelvic rest , and no
vaginal exams . Any bleeding means return
immediately, and serial ultrasounds track
whether the placenta moves away from the
cervix.
